title: echium lusitanicum subsp. polycaulon
intro: Echium lusitanicum subsp. polycaulon, commonly known as Purple Viper's Bugloss, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family, Boraginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Echium lusitanicum subsp. polycaulon include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic effects, attributed to its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation and reduce triglycerides and LDL cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily polyphenolic compounds, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
